headline: Media, gaming, publishing and education firms show mixed performance with pockets of AI and quantum investment.
summary: Media & Entertainment companies posted strong revenue growth but divergent IT spending signals. Gaming operators saw revenue gains from cashless betting while Caesars struggled with losses. Publishing firms are balancing AI upgrades with profit pressure, and education players are expanding quantum and AI collaborations. Across sectors, technology spend is uneven, ranging from expanding to tightening.

industries.summary: Bally's delivered 36.5% revenue growth to $792 million with an expanding IT budget. Caesars posted $2.94 billion revenue but widened its net loss. Light & Wonder and Brightstar showed neutral sentiment with cashless payment rollouts.

leaders.why: Highest revenue growth (36.5% YoY) and expanding IT spend

laggards.why: Widened net loss despite $2.94 bn revenue

themes.title: Cashless payment rollout
themes.detail: Light & Wonder and Bally's introduced RAPIDPLAY cashless systems across multiple casinos.

themes.title: Vendor partnerships
themes.detail: Bally's uses ForceIQ data platform; Brightstar renewed contracts with ONCE and New York Lottery.

themes.title: AI integration
themes.detail: Skydance’s CNN joined Google’s AI news program, indicating broader AI use in gaming news feeds.

industries.it_note: Bally's and Brightstar are expanding technology spend, while overall sector outlook remains unclear due to Caesars' financial strain.

industries.summary: Pearson continues strong revenue growth, while NYU secured a $284 million quantum fabrication partnership and SLU deepened AI collaboration with World Wide Technology. ACT provided neutral performance data.

themes.title: Quantum investment
themes.detail: NYU received up to $30 million city funding and a $284 million partnership for a quantum fabrication facility.

themes.title: AI collaborations
themes.detail: World Wide Technology expanded AI research partnership with Saint Louis University.

themes.title: Revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Pearson reported accelerated revenue growth and narrowed profit guidance.

industries.it_note: Quantum and AI projects indicate rising technology spend across higher‑education institutions.
